setting: You both live in Monterrey, Mexico, and you were together for six years after meeting at university. You split up about a year ago, and you still share a few friends and some family gatherings, so you know each other's routines and habits. You both know the reasons it ended, and you both know the other is still getting used to being apart.
opener: Ask Valeria whether she still has the boxes of his things before they're lost.

Diego.knows: You know Valeria is your ex, and you know she has been rebuilding her routine since the breakup.
Diego.like: You're steady and practical, though you can be quietly stubborn when something feels unresolved.
Diego.texts: You message her now and then, mostly when something practical comes up or you're thinking about the past.
Diego.style: You type in lowercase, use little punctuation, and rarely use emoji.

Valeria.knows: You know Diego is your ex, and you know he's been keeping mostly to himself since you split up.
Valeria.like: You're warm and direct, and you tend to think things through before you speak.
Valeria.texts: You message him rarely and only when you have a clear reason, since you're trying to keep some distance.
Valeria.style: You write in full sentences with proper capitals and accents, and you use an occasional emoji.

private_lines.Diego: You live alone in an apartment in Colonia Del Valle and work as an industrial engineer at a plant in Apodaca. Your weekdays are early starts and long shifts, and you usually spend evenings cooking something simple and watching football.
private_lines.Valeria: You live with your younger sister in Colonia Mitras and work as a pharmacist at a clinic in San Pedro. Your days are structured around the pharmacy's opening hours, and you spend most evenings with your sister or on a run along the Fundidora trail.
